spans.s: त॑र् m. (only nom. pl. ता॑रस्) star.
तरक्ष m. hyena.
ताराक्ष a. = तारकाक्ष.
तर॑क्षु m. hyena.
तरंग् तरं˚गति तरं˚ग˚ते wave, heave.

तरंगय् तरंग˚यति pp. तरंगित (q.v.) move to
and fro (trans.), toss.
तरंगवात m. air or wind coming from the waves.
तरण n. crossing, surpassing.
तरणित्व॑ n. eagerness, zeal.
तरणीय a. to be crossed or surpassed.
तरतमतस् adv. more or less.
तर॑द्द्वेषस् a. overwhelming enemies.
तर॑ध्यै dat. inf. to तृ.

तरलय् तरल˚यति pp. तरलित move to and fro,
shake (tr. & intr.).
तरलिका f. N. of a woman.*
2 तर॑स् a. rash, energetic.

तरस m. n. flesh;
 a. ˚मय consisting of flesh.
त॑रस्वन्त् a. rash, energetic, bold, valiant.
तरस्वि॑न् a. rash, energetic, bold, valiant.
तरि f. boat, ship.
तरी f. boat, ship.
1 तरी f. v. तरि.
2 तरी॑ f. = स्तरी॑.

तरिक m. ferry-man;
 f. आ boat.
तारिक n. fare or toll for passage.
तरिणी f. boat, ship.

तरिवार sword;
 ˚धारा f. sword-blade.*
त॑रीयंस् (compar.) running through (acc.).
तरीष॑णि (inf.) to run through (acc.).
1 त॑रु a. rash.
2 तरु m. tree.
तरुकोटर n. the hollow of a tree.
तरुगहन n. the thicket of a tree.
तरुच्छाया f. the shade of a tree.
तरुणय् तरुण˚यति refresh, strengthen.
तरुणादित्य m. the young (i.e. just risen) sun.
तरुणिम॑न् m. youth, juvenility.
तरुतल n. the place under a tree.
1 त॑रुतृ a. winning, conquering (acc.).
2 तरुतृ॑ m. conqueror, impeller (gen.).

त॑रुत्र a. carrying across;
 gaining or granting victory.
तरुमण्डप s. arbour, bower.
तरुमूल n. root of a tree, also = तरुतल.
तरुराजि f. row of trees, avenue.

तरुष् त॑रुषति त॑रुष˚ते overcome, vanquish. — आ
pass over, cross.

त॑रुस् n. fight, contest;
 superiority.

त॑रुष m. conqueror, vanquisher;
 f. ई victorious fight.
तरुषण्ड n. a group of trees.
तरुष्य् pp. तरुष्य॑न्त् fighting (tr.).
तरूट m. the root of the lotus.
त॑रूषस् a. victorious, superior.

तर्क् तर्कयति (तर्कय˚ते) suppose, conjecture, guess,
reflect, regard as (2 acc.), think of (acc.), think to (inf.). — परि
ponder, think over, consider as (2 acc.). वि suppose, conjecture,
reflect on (acc.), ascertain. सम् regard as (2 acc.).
तर्कसंग्रह m. T. of a work (v. prec.).

तर्किन् a. supposing, thinking, reasoning, skilled in
speculation or philosophy.
तर्कु s. spindle.

तर्ज् तर्जति (तर्ज˚ते), pp. तर्जित (q.v.) threaten,
menace, abuse, revile. C. तर्जयति, ˚ते = S. + deride, mock;
frighten, terrify. — अभि & वि C. scold, revile. परि C. threaten.
सम् C. = S.C.
तर्जित n. threat, menace.

तर्णक m. calf;
 any young animal.
तर्द॑ m. a sort of insect (lit. borer).
तर्दन n. hole, opening, cleft.
त॑र्द्मन् n. hole, opening, cleft.
तर्पणीय a. to be satiated or satisfied.
†तर्मन् v. सुत॑र्मन्.
त॑र्य m. N. of a man.

तार्य a. to be crossed or conquered;
 n. fare, toll.
तर्ष m. ˚ण n. thirst, greediness, desire.
तर्षित a. thirsty, desirous of (—˚).
तर्ष्या॑वन्त् a. thirsty.
त॑र्हण f. ई crushing.

त॑र्हि adv. at that time, in that case, then (often correl.
w. यर्हि, यद्, यदा, यत्र, यदि, चेद्);
 therefore, then, now, well
(esp. w. imper. or interr.).
तारकाक्ष a. star-eyed.
तारकान्तक m. the killer of Tāraka, i.e. Skanda.
तारकाराज m. the moon (lord of the stars).
तारकेश्वर m. the moon (lord of the stars).
तारकोपनिषद् f. T. of an Upaniṣad.

तारतम्य n. the being more or less, difference,
gradation, proportion.
तारल्य n. fickleness.
तारव f. ई belonging to a tree.
ताराधिप m. the moon (lord of the stars).
तारामय f. ई consisting of stars.
तारामृग m. N. of a lunar mansion.

तारामैत्रक n. spontaneous love (lit. the friendship
of the stars).
तारायण m. the holy fig tree.

तारिन् a. carrying over, rescuing;
 ˚णी f. E. of Durgā.
तारुण्य n. youth, juvenility.
तार्किक m. thinker, philosopher.

तार्क्ष m. a cert. bird;
 E. of Garuḍa & Kaśyapa.

ता॑र्क्ष्य m. N. of a mythical being, conceived as a horse,
later as a bird, also = prec.
तार्ण a. made of grass.

तार्तीयीक a. the third;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.
तार्प्य॑ n. a garment made of a cert. vegetable substance.
तार्प्य᳙ n. a garment made of a cert. vegetable substance.

तार्ष्टाघ m. a cert. tree;
 a. (f. ई) belonging to it.
